_note: Task set for the 13 experiment (9 tasks x 5 configs = 45 cells). T1/T2 reproduce the Day-2 run byte-for-byte (build_contexts.py --verify) and their ablation is frozen as executed. Every other task has ablation_mode=auto: its ablation_lines are COMPUTED by carrier_check.py --apply as the complete set of Tier-1 carriers, never hand-picked. 'anchors' are the terms that must ALL occur in an edge's evidence for that edge to be able to express the target fact. See task_selection.md for the exhaustive candidate list and the written selection rule.
